# Phillips

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## Appearance

He has a mustache which he curls.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

Mr. Phillips carries out his teaching duties with a rather high hand, often displaying a sarcastic inflection and a vindictive spirit. He is strict and quick to punish pupils when his temper is provoked, yet he neglects the younger students to spend time with the older scholars. He lacks imagination and shows favoritism toward certain female students.

_Sources: [v1 c11 P33](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0033), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)_

## Traits

- Sarcastic  <sub>[v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)</sub>
- Vindictive  <sub>[v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)</sub>
- Lacks imagination  <sub>[v1 c11 P33](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0033)</sub>

## Abilities

- Reciting dramatic speeches  <sub>[v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)</sub>

## Goals

- Prepare older scholars for the Queen's Academy entrance examination  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## History

Mr. Phillips served as the schoolmaster at Avonlea school. During his tenure, he spent much of his time sitting at the back of the room explaining Latin lessons to Prissy Andrews, whom he courted. He was known for maintaining scandalous order and frequently using sarcastic punishments, such as forcing Anne Shirley to stand on the platform under a blackboard legend criticizing her temper or making her sit beside Gilbert Blythe as a punishment for tardiness. He also took part in local events, giving a recitation of Mark Antony's oration at the Avonlea Debating Club concert and presenting Mayflowers to Prissy Andrews during a field afternoon. At the end of June, he resigned his position as teacher, making a tearful farewell speech to his pupils before leaving Avonlea.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v1 c21 P1](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0001), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## Background by volume

- Obtained his teaching position at Avonlea because his uncle was a school trustee  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- Boarded at the house of Eben Wright while teaching in Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056)</sub>
